name: Draining Scrib

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: The scrib throws itself at you, dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Spit
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing low poison damage.

abilities.name: Lingering Toxin
abilities.description: The scrib spits a lingering poison at a target, dealing 9 ticks of minor poison damage over time.

abilities.name: Cave In
abilities.description: While the Transmuted Hive Lord performs its "Cave In" attack the Draining Scrib burrows underground out of reach for the duration of the attack.

related_quests: What Was Lost: Help Shatasha investigate Dwemer ruins.
Pledge: Darkshade II: Explore Darkshade Caverns II and return Undaunted.
summary: The Draining Scrib is a kwama scrib that accompanies and supports the Transmuted Hive Lord in Darkshade Caverns II.
